calibration_note: Refit 2026-07-29 from a real walk-forward backtest: 162 real MLB games (2026-07-01 to 2026-07-12) with real historical Polymarket-reconstructed spread lines, real final scores, and point-in-time-correct reconstructed features (team form, starter ERA, real bullpen data, real empirical park factors, real historical weather). OLS fit of raw simulated cover probability against actual cover outcome. Correlation with real outcomes was weak but consistently positive across four independent formula revisions during this investigation (0.045-0.12) -- real, small signal, not fabricated confidence. Superseded the prior 0.85/0.075 placeholder, which was an unfit reasoned default identical to (and therefore not independently derived from) the totals artifact.
